name: @workspace/zio-browser
description: Zio Browser — AI-powered companion browser for Mac, Windows, and Linux

scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main
scripts.sync:zio-extension: pnpm --filter @workspace/1inme-extension run build:chrome && rm -rf build-resources/zio-extension && cp -r ../1inme-extension/dist/chrome build-resources/zio-extension
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:preload && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit
